The '''Reena Minor system''' was located in the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Reena Trade Route]]<ref name="TEA" /> as well as the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Reena/Legends|Reena]]<ref name="Tapani">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref> in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Reena system/Legends|Reena system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Reena Minor [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-14.<ref name="TEA" />
